title: Operationalize vector quantization calibration pipeline and cosine-similarity watchdog for embeddings
creator: Marina Patel
description:
Objective: Build a repeatable operational pipeline to produce INT8 and FP16 quantization profiles for production embedding models, validate quality via cosine similarity regression tests, and deploy an automated watchdog that raises alerts and triggers gated rollbacks when drift exceeds tolerances.

Scope: calibration pipelines (offline calibration + on-device profile generation), acceptance criteria and test harness for cosine-similarity comparisons across corpora, integration with Console dashboards and alerting, and an automated canary rollout path for applying new quant profiles to Dedicated fleets. This ticket focuses on engineering work (CI jobs, validation harness, monitoring hooks); downstream rollout runbook will live in the qa/runbooks repo.

Acceptance criteria:
- A CI job that generates INT8 and FP16 profiles from a representative calibration corpus and uploads artifacts to S3 with semantic tags (model, commit, profile-hash).
- A validation harness that runs cosine-similarity comparisons across 3 canonical corpora (global, wiki-like, short-chat) and produces a per-corpus report with mean, 5th percentile, and percentile delta vs baseline.
- Automated gating: block promotion if mean similarity drops >0.02 or 5th-percentile drops >0.06, or if user-facing regression (documented examples) appear in the top-50 nearest neighbors list.
- Console dashboard panels: daily profile drift, historical trend line per model/profile, and scheduled nightly calibration run status.
- Alerting: PagerDuty trigger for high-severity regressions, Slack notifications for minor regressions.
- Canary rollout integration: ability to route 5% traffic to quantized variant with auto-rollback based on similarity and latency SLOs.

Calibration workflow (engineer-facing):
1) Prepare calibration dataset: sample representative batches (min 200k vectors) from production corpora snapshots across three buckets (long-doc, short-doc, conversational).
2) Offline calibration run: quantize with per-channel symmetric INT8 and FP16 emulation, generate layer-wise scale tables and quant error histograms.
3) Profile synthesis: produce a profile artifact containing quant tables, calibration stats, and profile-hash.
4) Validation: run the similarity-harness comparing quantized embeddings to baseline float16 embeddings; compute cosine similarity metrics and nearest-neighbor preservation.
5) Publish: if gating passes, publish profile artifact to artifact store and open canary rollout via the deployment API.

Validation harness details:
- Metrics computed: mean cosine, median cosine, 5th percentile cosine, nn-preservation@k (k=10,50), rank-correlation Spearman on similarity lists, and downstream recall on a small semantic search task.
- Thresholds: mean cosine delta <= 0.02 (preferred <=0.01), 5th-percentile delta <= 0.06. These thresholds were chosen after offline experiments balancing cost savings vs UX impact.
- Sampling: deterministic sharding by user_id to ensure reproducible comparisons between runs.
- Regression examples: harness stores the top 20 pairs with largest delta for manual inspection and attaches them to the CI artifact metadata.

Monitoring & alerting design:
- Watchdog job runs hourly on new traffic profiles and nightly for full validation scans.
- If a watchdog run flags a regression beyond warning thresholds (mean delta >0.015) it opens a ticket in Linear and posts to #embed-ops.
- If a critical gate is violated during canary (mean delta >0.02 or latency SLO violated) the canary is automatically rolled back via the deployment API and an incident is created.

Rollout plan:
- Stage 1: internal calibration runs and manual QA for 2 models (small, medium) in staging.
- Stage 2: 5% canary in Dedicated for low-latency customers, monitor 48h.
- Stage 3: progressive rollout with 10x step increases if no alerts.

Open trade-offs & decisions:
- Per-channel symmetric INT8 chosen vs asymmetric per-tensor to reduce implementation complexity on older GPUs; may revisit if further accuracy gains are needed.
- We will keep FP16 as a lighter-weight profile for latency-sensitive workloads with tighter mean-delta thresholds.

Operations & runbook links: See links below for the CI job spec, canary runbook, and validation dashboard.

Longer-term items (out of scope for this ticket): online recalibration (incremental profile updates), automatic dataset curation to reduce bias, embedding-level drift explanations via attribution.
